title: LottosOnline Festive Giveaway
description: This festive season, LottosOnline is rewarding players with entry into our Festive Giveaway promotion every time they buy tickets. This offer is a great opportunity for new players to get a bonus.
h2: Entry is Your Ticket to Winning!
og_description: This festive season, LottosOnline is rewarding players with entry into our Festive Giveaway promotion every time they buy tickets. This offer is a great opportunity for new players to get a bonus.

copy.html:
At LottosOnline, we already give you access to the world's most exciting lotteries. Now, we're rewarding you this December with extra gifts! This is our biggest cash promotion ever, specifically for our valued customers.

We are giving away thousands of Euros and guaranteeing hundreds of prizes. With us, you get more than just a chance at monster jackpots from across the globe, you get free entries into a draw for a significant cash boost this festive season. Start playing today and grab your entries!

Entry is Your Ticket to Winning!

Getting into the draw couldn't be easier! For every qualifying purchase you make, you automatically snag an entry into our exciting Festive Giveaway:

  • 1 Ticket Line = 1 Entry
  • 1 Syndicate Share = 1 Entry
  • 1 Raffle Decimo = 1 Entry

🚀 The Formula is Simple: Play More, Win More Entries!

Don't Miss the Multiplier Madness!

Want to turbo-charge your chances?

Keep a close eye on our announcements! We'll be randomly activating Special Multiplier Events where your qualifying purchases will suddenly count for multiple entries! Maximise your play when the multipliers hit!

Unbelievable Prizes Await!

Hundreds of guaranteed winners will share in thousands of Euros! Check out the incredible prizes you could be taking home, including the chance to turn your winnings into an even BIGGER Reward Balance boost!

The Prize Breakdown is:

  • 1 Prize of €2,000.00 cash or €3,000.00 in Reward Balance
  • 3 Prizes of €1,000.00 cash or €1,500.00 in Reward Balance
  • 3 Prize of €500.00 cash or €750.00 in Reward Balance
  • 5 Prize of €100.00 cash or €150.00 in Reward Balance
  • 50 Prizes of €50.00 in Reward Balance
  • 50 Prizes of €25.00 in Reward Balance
  • 100 Prizes of €10.00 in Reward Balance
  • 200 Prizes of €5.00 in Reward Balance

Stop Dreaming, Start Winning!

This holiday season, give yourself the gift of a jackpot chance and a guaranteed entry into the prize draw. We're here to help you get the best shot at those mega jackpot prizes while racking up extra giveaway entries!

Ready to splash into the festive cash? Start Playing & Get Your Free Entries Now!


Start Playing!

The promotion runs until Wednesday 31st December at 23:59 GMT. For full terms and conditions of the Festive Giveaway, please visit the promotion's terms and conditions page.
